title: DOW-UAP-PR054, "Spherical UAP Erratic movement [CALLSIGN] (Mission) 2022"
what_is_it: Infrared video recorded by a U.S. military sensor platform, uploaded to a classified network and later released as part of the PURSUE collection.
interpretation_warnings: The video was digitally altered prior to upload — the nature and extent of alteration is not described

The video description text appears truncated, cutting off mid-sentence at 00:00–00:45
AARO uses 'likely derived from' rather than confirmed attribution to the sensor platform
